name: inv_eop
description: Inventory remaining at the end of the time period selected by the user.

name: margin
description: Net margin generated from the sales in the time period selected by the user.

name: quantity
description: Quantity of products sold during the selected time period.

name: sales
description: Revenue that was generated from sales during the the time period selected by the user.

name: gross_margin_perc
description: Overall average margin percentage earned on the total revenue generated by the business in the given time period.

name: aum
description: Average margin per unit sold by the business in the time period selected by the user.

name: aur
description: The average revenue generated per unit sold.

name: discount_units
description: Total quantity sold under discount (promo or other) by the business in the time period selected by the user
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN discount_flag = 'Discount' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END)

name: discount_margin
description: Margin from the sales under discount by the business in the time period selected by the user
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN discount_flag = 'Discount' THEN margin ELSE 0 END)

name: avg_discount_perc
description: Average value of the overall discount apllied on products during the time period selected by the user.
formula: (SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN discount_flag = 'Discount' THEN discount_numerator ELSE 0 END), SUM(quantity))) * 100

name: transactions
description: Total number of the transactions happened in the business during the timeframe selected by the user.

name: avg_basket_value
description: Average revenue generated per transaction during the selected time period.

name: avg_basket_size
description: The average number of units sold per transaction.

name: discount_sales
description: Total revenue generated by the products under discount in the time period selected by the user
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN discount_flag = 'Discount' THEN sales ELSE 0 END)

name: forecast_qty
description: The time period for which the forecasting data  is present .

name: freshness
description: freshness

name: planned_quantity
description: Planned sales units

name: planned_sales
description: Planned sales

name: planned_eoh
description: Planned end of period inventory.

name: planned_margin
description: Planned margin

name: planned_aur
description: Planned aur

name: planned_aum
description: Planned aum

name: planned_gross_margin_perc
description: Planned Gross Margin Percent

name: total_inventory
description: Includes beginning and any new purchases of the inventory

name: sell_through
description: Percentage of the units sold with respect to the beginning period inventory and any new inventory purchased in the selected time period.
formula: safe_divide(SUM(sales_qty) OVER(PARTITION BY {AGG_LEVEL}), (SUM(reciepts) OVER(PARTITION BY {AGG_LEVEL}) + boh))

name: inv_bop
description: Inventory remaining at the beginning of the time period selected by the user.

name: oh
description: Number of units of all the products present at the store in the time period selected by the user.

name: it
description: Number of units of all the products on the way from the warehouse to the store in the time period selected by the user.

name: oo
description: Order placed for the number of units of all the products in the time period selected by the user

name: woi
description: The time period for which the inventory will last.
